sections.title: Command registry
sections.content: Defines red/green and terminal validation programs for canonical evidence, migration, Bootstrap runtime, acceptance pipeline, projection/segmentation, semantic import, and rollout regression. Commands are non-shell Python pytest or validation invocations with bounded timeouts and mapped acceptance IDs; terminal green coverage is explicitly enumerated. No authorization is granted.

sections.title: Requirements and acceptance
sections.content: Defines ARBE-001 through ARBE-022 and acceptance IDs ARBE-A01 through ARBE-A46. Core requirements cover identity-bound admission, changed-set and typed closure, real checks, policy routes, isolated review roles, range projection and segment identity, liveness/retry controls, evidence import, shared canonical evidence migration, historical replay, rollout metrics, and a fixed supervised/unattended route matrix. Bootstrap and advisory material cannot independently authorize acceptance; only Acceptance may publish acceptance-passed.
